en.faq_desc: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions about our services.
en.faq1_q: What services does HSN Metal Construction offer?
en.faq1_a: We manufacture and install stairs, railings, fences, gates, doors, carports, facades, and custom fabrications. Repairs and maintenance are also part of our service.
en.faq2_q: Do you also work for private clients?
en.faq2_a: Yes, we serve both private clients and businesses. Whether it's a residential building, office, or industrial facility   we deliver tailor-made solutions for every need.
en.faq3_q: What materials do you work with?
en.faq3_a: We process steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and glass. Combinations are particularly popular   for example, stainless steel railings with safety glass for a modern, elegant look.
en.faq4_a: After your inquiry, we provide free consultation, create a non-binding quote, and produce CAD drawings. After your approval, we handle fabrication and installation   on time and cleanly.
en.faq5_q: Can you also implement custom fabrications?
en.faq5_a: Yes, we specialize in tailor-made solutions. From special design ideas to specific dimensions, we implement your wishes professionally and precisely.
en.faq6_q: In which area do you operate?
en.faq6_a: We are mainly active in the Kraichtal, Karlsruhe, and Baden-Württemberg region. For larger projects, we are also available nationwide   please contact us.
en.footer_desc: Master craftsman business for metal construction, steel construction, and locksmithing in Kraichtal. For over 20 years, we have been manufacturing custom metal solutions with the highest precision and quality.
